ideas.pitch: A localized digital bookkeeping, automated invoicing, and credit-tracking web app specifically designed for university campus vendors, canteens, and photocopier shops.
ideas.title: CampusVendor - Local Micro-Business Trust & Invoicing Engine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets local campus economies and small-scale entrepreneurship, which resonates strongly with a judging panel organized by an institutional Entrepreneurship Cell.

ideas.pitch: An open-innovation logistics routing and cost-estimation tool tailored for regional manufacturing small businesses to optimize local delivery schedules and minimize fuel overhead.
ideas.title: IndusLogi - MSME Last-Mile Supply Chain Route Optimizer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Provides concrete, measurable economic benefit and operational cost reduction, appealing directly to the business-thinking criteria mandated by the challenge.

ideas.pitch: A streamlined mobile web platform that connects local farmers directly with urban residential housing societies for bulk vegetable pre-orders, eliminating middlemen.
ideas.title: AgriBridge - Direct Farm-to-Consumer Aggregation MVP
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses on solving an authentic real-world agricultural supply inefficiency with a clear social and economic impact narrative ready for a 7-slide pitch deck.

ideas.pitch: An internal credential and skill-exchange platform that matches senior engineering students with juniors for project mentorship, portfolio reviews, and collaborative coding sessions.
ideas.title: SkillSwap PCCOER - Peer-to-Peer Technical Mentorship Marketplace
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves an immediate pain point familiar to both students and engineering department organizers in the room, making the demo instantly relatable to the judging panel.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered document parsing tool that reads complex Indian health insurance policy PDFs and instantly highlights exclusions, claim ratios, and hidden clauses in plain language.
ideas.title: MedClaimCheck - Automated Health Insurance Policy Simplifier
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses a widespread, highly frustrating consumer finance problem using practical document intelligence, making for a compelling Shark Tank-style live demo.
